Understanding the future of manufacturing.

Bangladesh 4: Gearing up the Future of Manufacturing

A firm-level technology adoption survey for the World Bank: questionnaire, programming guidance, fieldwork training, data quality control and analysis for a policy report covering eight manufacturing sectors.

What I did.

  1. Supported the Task Team Leader in research, design, implementation and policy advocacy of the large technology adoption survey in Bangladesh.
  2. Contributed questionnaire design, survey implementation, data analysis and report writing for the Bangladesh study.
  3. Provided training to firms for survey implementation and guided survey teams for questionnaire programming, administration, monitoring and data-quality control.
  4. Organized high-level dissemination seminars and collaborated with lead economists from the World Bank.

The assignment.

The Firm-level Adoption of Technology Survey is designed to identify the level of technology adoption by Bangladeshi firms, identify key barriers to improving firm productivity and product quality, and identify policy reforms to address those barriers. Related publications: "Gearing Up for the Future of Manufacturing in Bangladesh" and "Bridging the Technological Divide: Technology Adoption by Firms in Developing Countries".
